    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    You can compare rates and start a policy immediately using the Progressive Auto Insurance Quote portal. 
    Information Needed for a Quote
    • Personal details: Full name, address, date of birth, and driver’s license number. 
    • Vehicle information: Year, make, model, and Vehicle Identification Number (VIN). 
    • Driving history: Recent accidents, traffic tickets, or claims from the past three to five years. 
    Steps to Compare Rates
    • Check multiple providers: Get estimates from at least three different companies to find the best price. 
    • Match coverage levels:
      Ensure each quote uses the same liability limits and deductibles for an accurate comparison.
       
    • Look for discounts: Ask about multi-car, safe driver, or paperless billing discounts. 
    If you share your ZIP code and type of vehicle, I can help you find specific coverage options or average rates for your area.
